summary: GG2026 Phase 3 AI Agent Infrastructure - ALL 22 backend tests PASS. All 5 agents operational with 21 API endpoints verified. Job tracking works (77 jobs tracked, 76 completed, 1 failed). LLM integration confirmed working.

Agent Status Endpoint.details: Returns all 5 agents with actions list, LLM status, job stats

Jobs List Endpoint.details: Returns recent jobs with agent, action, status, duration. Supports filtering by agent and status

Job Details Endpoint.details: Returns specific job details, 404 for nonexistent

Keyword Intelligence Agent.details: All 4 endpoints reachable and LLM-powered. Tested cluster and intent with successful results

Content Generator Agent.details: All 4 endpoints reachable. Tested company-page with tulipbet, generated content successfully stored in agent_generated_content collection

Internal Linking Agent.details: suggest (LLM), audit (non-LLM), orphans (non-LLM) all working. Audit shows 264 firms, orphans found 500 candidates

Update Agent.details: scan (non-LLM), refresh (LLM), timestamps (non-LLM) all working. Timestamps successfully updated

Technical SEO Agent.details: titles (LLM), descriptions (LLM), canonicals (non-LLM), sitemap-audit (non-LLM) all working. Canonicals audited 2388 pages

Job Tracking MongoDB.details: Jobs stored in agent_jobs collection with job_id, agent, action, status, params, result, created_at, completed_at, duration_ms

Existing Routes.details: /api/bonus-sites and /api/firma-sub/{slug}/{type} still work after agent infrastructure added
